facts.title: Fresh Mint Dressing
ingredients: ¼ cup packed fresh mint (spearmint) leaves (about half of a ⅔ or ¾-ounce package)
10 twists of freshly ground black pepper
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: In a food processor, combine all of the ingredients and blend until smooth. Taste, and add more salt and/or pepper if necessary. Use as desired!
This dressing will keep well, covered and refrigerated, for up to 1 week.

notes: Recipe inspired by The Mixx in Kansas City, and adapted from dressing recipes in my cookbook, Love Real Food.
Make it vegan: Use maple syrup instead of honey.
facts.summary: This mint salad dressing recipe is refreshing, delicious and easy to make! You’ll need fresh mint, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, and honey or maple syrup. Recipe yields a little over 1 cup.
